summary: Implemented ffmpeg-backed WebP screenshot generation in the worker with regression tests, worker build verification, and Docker-based ffmpeg validation.

docker_ffmpeg_validation.encoder_check_command: docker run --rm --entrypoint ffmpeg streaming-digest-worker-test -encoders 2>/dev/null | grep -i webp
docker_ffmpeg_validation.generation_command: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests/Fixtures/video/test-screenshot.mp4:/tmp/input.mp4:ro" -v "/tmp/streaming-digest-docker-validate:/tmp/out" --entrypoint ffmpeg streaming-digest-worker-test -y -loglevel error -ss 1 -i /tmp/input.mp4 -frames:v 1 -c:v libwebp -quality 80 /tmp/out/screenshot.webp
